title: PikoBuy Image Search: Find and Verify a Product
description: Use PikoBuy image search to find product candidates, compare seller listings and variants, and check warehouse photos before shipping.
body:
Start with a clear reference image

PikoBuy’s public homepage advertises image search alongside product links and sourcing requests. The feature can help when you have a photograph but no Taobao, Weidian or other source URL. It does not establish that two visually similar listings contain the same item, come from the same seller or have the same materials. Treat the first results as candidates for investigation, not verified matches.

Choose a reference that shows one product clearly. Crop away faces, addresses, chat messages, watermarks covering the item and unrelated objects. Keep the product’s outline, distinctive details and proportions visible. For a shoe, a side view may help with shape, while a second image of the sole can distinguish similar designs. For a bag, retain the closure, handle shape and pocket arrangement.

Keep the uncropped reference as well as the search version. A tight crop may improve visual matching but hide a feature you need later. Do not upload another person’s private order screenshot or a photograph containing personal information. If the original image is blurry or heavily edited, seek a clearer reference before making a purchase decision.

Run the search and keep useful candidates

Open PikoBuy’s current official interface and use the image-search option when available. Upload the prepared image and inspect the returned results. Interface labels, accepted file types and availability can change, so follow the live controls rather than assuming a permanent button location. If the feature is unavailable, use a descriptive keyword search or the platform’s current sourcing-request process.

Start with two or three plausible candidates instead of opening dozens of nearly identical cards. Record the original listing URL, seller name, selected option, displayed price and date checked. A result thumbnail is not enough evidence: open the source listing and compare the photographs, description and available variants. Keep the reference image beside these notes so you can explain what matched and what did not.

A broad search can produce accessories, replacement parts or miniature versions of the pictured object. Read the complete option label and what is included. A low price may belong to one accessory, one component or a different size. Confirm the actual purchasable item before using the displayed figure in your budget.

Compare the details that distinguish a real match

Check silhouette, dimensions, material claims, construction, color and included pieces separately. Matching a photograph’s color is weaker evidence than matching a distinctive seam, pocket arrangement or sole shape. Lighting and editing can change apparent color, while sellers may reuse promotional images across several variants. Shared pictures alone do not establish a shared supplier or identical stock.

For clothing, compare the seller’s garment measurements with a similar item you already own. For shoes, use the listing’s size system and any actual measurements rather than relying on a generic conversion chart. For bags and accessories, check dimensions and hardware. For electronics, model numbers, plug requirements and stated specifications matter more than visual similarity, and a listing cannot by itself prove safety or performance.

Write down unresolved differences before ordering. For example: the reference shows two pockets, the candidate has one; the reference sole is flat, the candidate has a raised heel; the candidate’s price refers to a single piece rather than a set. These concrete differences help you decide whether to keep searching or ask for clarification.

Turn the candidate into an exact order

Paste the complete product URL into the current PikoBuy buying interface and verify that it resolves to the expected seller and item. Select the exact color, size, model and quantity. Compare the imported price and variant with the source listing. If the import fails or options are missing, use the link-troubleshooting guide before paying; do not choose a different item simply because it imports successfully.

Use order notes for a clear, verifiable request, such as the required variant label or a measurement to confirm. A note cannot guarantee an option the seller does not offer. If a requirement is essential and not confirmed in the listing, resolve it first. Save the selected variant and current listing evidence because photos, stock and prices can change later.

Budget for separate stages. The first purchase may include merchandise and seller-to-warehouse delivery; international shipping is selected later for the packed parcel. Screen the intended goods for destination and route restrictions before committing. Finding an item through image search does not mean every route can carry it, particularly when batteries, liquids or unusual dimensions are involved.

Use warehouse photos to check the item received

When the item reaches the warehouse, compare its photographs with your saved order specification. Check that the selected color, label, quantity and visible construction match. Inspect the details that made this candidate suitable during research. If the picture search was based on a particular closure or sole shape, make sure the received item’s photos show that feature clearly.

Request a focused additional photograph or measurement when a missing detail changes the keep-or-return decision. PikoBuy’s shipping terms describe paid detailed photos as an option; check current availability and price. A useful request identifies the item and the precise view needed. Asking for a visible size label or a heel-to-toe measurement is more actionable than asking for better quality control.

Warehouse photographs cannot establish authenticity, material composition, long-term durability or internal function. They help with visible condition and specification checks. If the item is unsuitable, inspect the current return rules promptly and contact official support through the order. Eligibility depends on the item, seller, condition and timing; do not wait until international dispatch to raise a warehouse discrepancy.

Keep a short comparison record

A simple record should contain the reference image, source URL, seller, exact variant, current product price, domestic delivery, open questions and warehouse decision. Add estimated international shipping separately so that a cheap-looking candidate is not confused with the cheapest delivered option. Once the warehouse has measured the goods, replace provisional weight and size assumptions with the available figures.

For a hypothetical comparison, candidate A could match the reference shape but lack a size chart, while candidate B could show measurements but use a different closure. Neither is automatically the better purchase. The decision depends on which feature matters and whether the missing evidence can be obtained. This is a comparison method, not a claim about a real seller or product.

Before submitting a parcel, confirm that the received variant is acceptable, the route permits the contents and the final shipping quote fits the budget. Keep your research notes until delivery. A successful image search ends with a checked order and a documented decision, rather than with the first visually convincing thumbnail.
intro: A product photo can start a search, but the final decision needs a seller, a working listing and an exact variant. Use this image-search workflow to move from a reference picture to a purchase you can check.

title: PikoBuy Link Not Working? Taobao & Weidian Checks
description: Troubleshoot PikoBuy product links: separate a broken source listing from import errors, missing variants and unavailable stock before paying.
body:
Identify which part of the link failed

There are several different problems behind the phrase PikoBuy link not working. The source marketplace may no longer show the listing; a shared message may contain a shortened link and extra text; the PikoBuy importer may fail to display the item; or the product may load while a particular color or size is unavailable. Record the error and distinguish these situations before trying a workaround.

Open the original marketplace listing through its normal interface. Check the seller, product title and available variants. If the marketplace requires an account or app, use its supported access method. Do not interpret a sign-in prompt as proof that the listing was deleted. Equally, do not bypass an access restriction or enter credentials into a third-party link-cleaning service.

If the source itself reports that the listing is unavailable, look for a current link from the seller or use a sourcing request. A different listing with similar photos is a new candidate that needs its own checks. Product images, cached titles and an old spreadsheet entry cannot establish that the original item is still for sale.

Copy a complete product URL

Use the marketplace’s product share or browser address function and separate the URL from surrounding promotional text. A copied message can include a title, invitation, coupon language and more than one link. Paste the actual product URL into the buying interface. Keep the original message privately so you can compare it if the shortened link opens an unexpected destination.

When a legitimate share link redirects to a full product page, confirm the final seller and item before copying that address. Do not delete parameters at random: some identify the product or selected option. Avoid manually reconstructing a Taobao or Weidian URL from a number unless the source platform itself provides that exact destination. A syntactically valid URL can still point to the wrong listing.

Check for missing characters, punctuation copied after the URL and accidental spaces. If a browser shows a security warning or an unexpected domain, stop and obtain a fresh link from the original seller or marketplace. A link resolver should never need your PikoBuy password or payment details merely to show a product.

Check the imported seller and variant

Paste the complete URL into PikoBuy’s current search or buying flow. Its beginner guide describes link-based ordering from sources including Taobao, Tmall, 1688, Weidian and Yupoo. That published workflow does not guarantee that every listing or share-link format imports at every moment. A temporary failure needs a source check and, where available, the supported manual or sourcing flow.

If an item loads, compare its title, seller, image, option labels and displayed price with the source. Select the exact size, color, model and quantity. A working page with missing variants is not a completed order. Do not pay for a default option while assuming an order note will substitute for the correct selection.

Record any mismatch clearly. For example: the source lists three colors but the imported page shows one; the source size option is unavailable; or the item image belongs to an accessory rather than the intended main product. Take screenshots that show the product evidence without exposing personal account details. A concrete mismatch is easier for support to investigate than a generic report that the link is broken.

Handle Yupoo albums and incomplete listings

An image album can document appearance without supplying a normal checkout, stock status or a usable price. If a Yupoo reference does not resolve into a purchasable item, ask for the associated source listing or use the currently supported sourcing process. Include the album URL, exact image or model reference, desired variant and any seller information already provided.

Do not treat a placeholder price, an album title or a social-media caption as a confirmed purchase quote. Ask what the order will contain and how the exact option is identified. If the seller cannot provide dimensions or a clear variant specification, decide whether that uncertainty is acceptable before payment.

When you have only an image, use the image-search workflow to collect candidates and then verify each listing. Visual similarity is useful for discovery but cannot repair missing seller, stock or pricing information. Save the chosen listing as a new source rather than silently replacing the original link in your records.

Use a focused support or sourcing request

If the original listing works but import still fails, provide official support with the full source URL, marketplace, current error text, time checked and the exact variant you want. Mention whether the problem affects the whole product page or just one option. Use the platform’s supported request channel; do not send account passwords or unrelated payment screenshots.

A practical request can state: the source page opens, the desired option is the black model in size 42, and the importer does not display its size selector. Ask whether that exact variant can be purchased and what additional information is needed. This describes the required outcome without assuming a cause such as a platform outage or seller ban.

If you already paid, work from the existing order record before creating a duplicate. Check whether the purchase is awaiting confirmation, needs a response or has been cancelled. A second order can create duplicate purchases while the first remains active. Preserve the original order number and ask support to clarify its status.

Verify the order after the link is fixed

A successful import resolves only the technical step. Recheck the merchandise price, domestic delivery, selected quantity and any displayed charges. Save the final order summary and original source evidence. Product availability may change between discovery and purchasing, so rely on the confirmed order rather than an earlier cached result.

When warehouse photographs arrive, compare them with the saved variant and listing. If the import required manual clarification, pay particular attention to the feature that was ambiguous. Request a targeted additional photograph when necessary and review current return eligibility before submitting international shipping.

Keep separate records for source discovery, purchasing, warehouse inspection and the parcel. The source URL explains what you asked to buy; the order explains what was purchased; warehouse evidence shows what arrived; and the parcel record tracks dispatch. Maintaining those distinctions prevents a corrected link from hiding a later specification or delivery problem.
intro: When a Taobao or Weidian link does not load in PikoBuy, first establish whether the original listing works. Then check the URL, imported item and exact options. A failed import does not automatically mean the product is unavailable.

title: PikoBuy Shoe Size Guide: Measurements & QC Checks
description: Choose a PikoBuy shoe size using the seller’s chart, compare measurements, and inspect shoe QC photos before approving international shipping.
body:
Read the listing’s sizing system first

A shoe listing may use EU, UK, US or a length-based size label. Even within one system, fit can vary by model and construction. Check whether the chart refers to foot length, insole length, an internal measurement or an outsole measurement. Those figures describe different things and should not be substituted for one another.

Keep the seller’s size chart and the exact option label with your order notes. If the source chart and imported selector disagree, resolve the mismatch before payment. Do not rely on a universal conversion table or another buyer’s usual size to settle an unclear listing. A conversion can help interpret labels, but it does not prove the fit of the product being sold.

Read any model-specific instructions about width, lining, fit or recommended allowance. Ask for clarification when a chart does not define its measurement. This guide does not prescribe one universal amount of extra space: the appropriate allowance depends on the model, intended use and the seller’s measurement method.

Make measurements that can be compared

Measure both feet under consistent conditions and keep the larger relevant measurement for comparison. Stand naturally with the type of socks you intend to wear. Record the heel-to-longest-toe length and, where the seller provides useful width guidance, the relevant width. Use the seller’s stated method when it is available rather than combining incompatible measurement techniques.

A comfortable pair you already own can provide a second reference, especially if its construction is similar. However, a removable insole measurement is not automatically equal to usable internal space or foot length. Note how the reference was measured and compare like with like. A tape placed around a curved edge will not produce the same result as a straight measurement.

Record units explicitly. Confusing millimeters, centimeters and inches can produce a large error, while rounding can matter near a boundary. If your measurement falls between two options, ask for the model-specific recommendation and consider how the shoes will be used. Do not present a larger size as a guaranteed fix for uncertain width or shape.

Order the exact pair and preserve the specification

Select the required color, size label, model and quantity in the buying interface. Confirm that the order is for a pair and that the pictured variant matches the chosen option. A main listing photo may represent a different color or edition from the selected SKU. Save the source URL, chart, option text and any seller clarification before payment.

Use order notes for an objective requirement that can be checked, such as requesting confirmation of the listed size label. A note cannot change a seller’s stock or guarantee a particular fit. If the required measurement is not available before ordering, recognize that uncertainty and review the current return conditions rather than assuming a later exchange will be possible.

Plan the cost of the whole purchase. Product price and China domestic delivery belong to the purchasing stage; international shipping is assessed later for the packed parcel. Shoe boxes and protective packaging can affect its dimensions. A low product price does not establish a low delivered cost.

Inspect both shoes in the warehouse photos

Begin with identity and completeness. Check that there are two shoes, that their size labels agree with the order and each other, and that the color and model match the selected variant. Inspect the pair from the front, side, heel and outsole where those views are available. Differences in camera angle can affect apparent symmetry, so seek a clearer view before concluding that a pair is mismatched.

Look for visible damage, separated seams, loose stitching, stains, obvious glue marks and deformation. Compare heel alignment, sole shape, eyelets and closures. A cosmetic mark and a structural concern may require different decisions. Describe what is visible and where it appears instead of making a broad claim that the entire product is defective.

Warehouse QC photographs do not authenticate a shoe or establish its material composition, comfort, durability or safety. They also cannot simulate trying it on. Use photos to resolve observable questions, and avoid treating an attractive picture as proof of overall quality.

Request a useful measurement photo

If sizing remains uncertain, ask whether the warehouse can provide the specific measurement you need and check the current fee. PikoBuy’s shipping terms describe additional detailed photographs as a paid option, but availability and charges should be confirmed in the live order. Make the request before approving the item for international dispatch.

Specify the item, measurement endpoints, unit and required camera view. For a removable insole, ask whether it can be measured flat with the heel and toe ends visible beside the tape. Do not request removal if it would damage the product or invalidate its condition. If removal is unsuitable, ask what alternative measurement is possible and how it should be interpreted.

A useful photograph shows the tape’s starting point, endpoint and units without a hidden bend. Compare it with a reference measured in the same way. For a hypothetical example, an insole reading of 27 cm cannot be directly compared with a foot-length chart entry of 27 cm as though both guarantee the same fit. The purpose of the measurement must match.

Decide before international shipping

If the pair matches the ordered specification and the available measurements are acceptable, document that decision and then plan the parcel. If a size label is wrong, a shoe is missing or a critical measurement conflicts with confirmed seller guidance, raise the specific discrepancy promptly. Keep the listing evidence and warehouse photos together so support can compare the request with what arrived.

Returns and exchanges depend on current eligibility, seller consent, condition and timing. PikoBuy’s published returns terms describe a five-day, 120-hour window for eligible warehoused items beginning from the next hour after warehousing; check the live policy and order promptly. Do not assume every product can be returned or that every return is free. International dispatch makes the decision substantially harder to reverse.

Consider packaging only after resolving the keep-or-return decision. Retaining a box may help preserve presentation and some protection but can add volume; removing it may reduce bulk while exposing the shoes to different risks. Compare the final route quote and packing options for the actual parcel. Save the pair’s photographs, size information and parcel record until delivery, then inspect the received goods before discarding packaging.
intro: The most useful shoe-size reference is the exact seller’s measurement guidance for the exact model. Combine it with measurements you can compare and warehouse photos of the received pair; a familiar EU or US number alone is not enough.
